dct_description_sm: This study sought to answer several questions. First, are diatom assemblages in Siberian lakes across treeline different in boreal forest versus tundra regions, and if so, which limnological factors influence diatom community composition? Second, are these explanatory factors consistent in all three regions and related to climatic gradients across treeline, or are they regionally distinct? Finally, are regional determinants of water chemistry, such as lithology or ocean proximity, stronger influences on diatom assemblages than climatic gradients across treeline when the regional calibration sets are combined? The information presented in this study should be useful as a basis for paleolimnological studies at circumpolar treeline and for providing a more thorough understanding of the diatom ecology from northern treeline lakes.
dct_title_s: Limnological data from lakes in central arctic Siberia and northern Russia
